biography: Proven Executive Leader of fast paced, highly integrated Semiconductor and Hyperscale datacenter construction projects at a global scale. Leading teams to deliver high performance results in Safety, Quality and predictable Schedule and Cost. As leaders, we own setting the tone and cultural expectations for Safety, as the core value on our projects. This expectation includes the physical safety as well as mental health and well-being for everyone. Together, we are fully committed and believe that it is possible to execute construction without worker injury or incident every day. As a Diversity and Inclusion Advocate, I am fully committed to enabling and growing an inclusive environment where everyone's inputs and ideas are welcomed. This requires us to fully support inclusive hiring, as well as embrace and promote a safe space for all members of the team.
